authority: ADR 0021 — automated acceptance and sampled capacity; maintainer merge is the sole human acceptance
note: One entry per requirement this increment accepts by merge: a finding, a work package or a Gate B criterion. runtime_owner names the code that carries the behaviour, tests the proofs, artifacts the workflow jobs that run them, decision the governing record. delivered means the entry has left docs/roadmap/findings.json and is written into CHANGELOG.md; open means it is still in the ledger with an outstanding note; separate-track means a later increment owns it. composer acceptance:check verifies every claim and composer acceptance:summary derives docs/roadmap/acceptance-summary.md.
